wiki.title: Alison H. Clarkson
wiki.extract: Alison Hudnut Clarkson (born April 26, 1955) is an American theatrical producer and politician. She served as the majority leader of the Vermont Senate from 2021 to 2025, representing the Windsor district as a member of the Democratic Party. Before entering the state senate, she served in the Vermont House of Representatives from the Windsor 5th district from 2005 to 2017.
